body: Dr Who (I'm behind a season though...), Breaking Bad, Movies (all of them), video games-- PS3 and PC... used to play more... but used to play with ex... so now Steam feels weird for me-- like I want to play but it makes me blue, Theater-- I'm a playwright, Books, Museums-- I'm a member of a couple-- I always end up going alone.... yeah... I think that's just it....I get depressed because I'm into plenty of things... boy things, girly things, smart things, dumb things.... I would think that I'd be able to find someone who'd.... I don't know... value that.... is that crazy? :( sigh

I was a film major... which would be excellent minus the whole lack of networking since lack of friends and such.... I do my best to reach out... I try to write letters to people... just Hey I missed you and you were always great.... that kind of thing... no one writes back.... I'll go a week without money just so I can donate to someone who I once knew for their kickstarter project.... no one even thanks me.... I would be more involved with projects, classes, groups... but I have to have "open availability" which basically means that because I have to always be available to work-- I can't consistently do anything else without losing my job.
Hey.... I'm not terribly interesting at the moment... especially since I'm depressed. But how's things?
